# MDL303 · `inline-comment`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A `#` comment after a value is part of the value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | K10 |

## Why

GLib has no end-of-line comments: in `threads=4 # four threads` the value is `4 # four threads`, which an integer option rejects (mydumper aborts at startup), and which silently changes a path, a name or a regular expression. In SQL values such as `where`, a `#` outside quotes comments out the rest of the statement mydumper builds. The fix moves the comment to its own line above, unless it contains `[` (which would change how the pre-processor reads the next lines). [client] is not checked: the MySQL client library does strip such comments.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4 # four threads
outputdir=/backup	# nightly
[`db`.`t`]
where=name = 'a # b' # not in quotes
[client]
user=backup # MySQL strips this
```

```text
2:11-2:25 warning MDL303[inline-comment] `# four threads` is part of the value of `threads`: GLib has no end-of-line comments
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Cannot parse integer value “4 # four threads” for --threads, try --help".
  fix (unsafe): Move the comment to its own line above
3:19-3:28 warning MDL303[inline-comment] `# nightly` is part of the value of `outputdir`: GLib has no end-of-line comments
  = The value is `/backup\t# nightly`, not `/backup`.
  fix (unsafe): Move the comment to its own line above
5:22-5:37 warning MDL303[inline-comment] `# not in quotes` is part of the value of `where`: GLib has no end-of-line comments
  = The comment runs to the end of the SQL statement mydumper builds, cutting what follows it.
  fix (unsafe): Move the comment to its own line above
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
# four threads
threads=4
# nightly
outputdir=/backup
[`db`.`t`]
# not in quotes
where=name = 'a # b'
[client]
user=backup # MySQL strips this
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL303: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL303` on the line above it.
